QUOTE: "Saves that pending state, then calls `client.createPost` once more." and "On failure, either removes the post (for the same three errors) or sets `props.failed` again so the user can retry." and "Each retry is a single manual attempt."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states `retryFailedPost` makes one new `createPost` attempt, and on failure it either removes the post for the same three errors or marks it failed again. It also notes there is no automatic retry, and the zero-retry setting covers the no-backoff part.
